info.title: DEWA API
info.description: Bilingual (ar/fr) healthcare marketplace API. Every response uses the envelope `{ success, data, error: { code, message_key, message, details }, meta: { request_id, pagination } }`. Send `Accept-Language: ar` or `fr` to localise `error.message`. Full guides: /docs/api/*.md in the repo.
